description: Arduino Nano V3.0-class ATmega328P board; USB belongs to the external serial bridge

firmware_generation.interrupts: INT0/INT1 through D2/D3; timer and peripheral vectors remain board-core owned
firmware_generation.boot: Optiboot-compatible 2 KiB boot section; application upload through the external USB-UART bridge; the provider exposes an application restart because watchdog reset is unsafe with the old bootloader

persistent_storage.note: Runtime program-flash mutation is unavailable to the exact old-Optiboot application; EEPROM is the bounded writable persistence provider
